candidates.name: SIGNED KIT — Agency Application & Digitals Kit for aspiring models
candidates.one_line: A US$34 Etsy/Gumroad digital kit for aspiring models and their parents: compiled, dated, per-agency submission specs for 150-250 verified legitimate agencies (US/UK/EU + a Portuguese Brazil edition), a phone-shot digitals checklist with framing guides, measurement sheet, application tracker, and a scam red-flag checklist.
candidates.buyer: An aspiring model aged 16-24, or the parent of a teen, who has decided to apply to agencies this month — or has just been DMed by a suspicious 'scout' and wants to do it the legitimate way.
candidates.why_they_buy_now: The application moment is acute and anxious: they are about to shoot digitals and submit, they know agencies reject unclear/over-edited submissions, and they fear scams. The kit is bought the week they decide to apply — the same week they are searching 'modeling digitals template' and 'how to apply to a modeling agency online'.
candidates.demand_evidence: [VERIFIED, fetched suggestqueries.google.com 2026-08-07] Google autocomplete returned: 'modeling agency near me for kids', '...for teens', '...for beginners', 'how to apply to a modeling agency online', 'model digitals template', 'modeling digitals examples/outfit/photographer near me' — all live completions, meaning sustained search volume. [VERIFIED, fetched html.duckduckgo.com] Etsy has auto-generated market pages at etsy.com/market/modeling_digitals_template and /market/modeling_digitals — Etsy only creates these for queried categories. [VERIFIED, fetched creativemarket.com/search?q=comp card] The adjacent comp-card template market is saturated at US$9-10 (Designscozy, TemplatesForest, 20+ near-identical listings) — proof aspiring models buy on marketplaces, and proof the design-template angle is dead while the information/spec angle is empty. [VERIFIED, WebSearch] A search for paid agency-list/submission-spec guides returned only free generic blog posts (pixpa.com, photogenicsmedia.com) — no compiled paid product found. Etsy listing-level sales counts: [UNKNOWN], Etsy blocks fetching (403/captcha on all routes tried).
candidates.channel: Etsy search ('modeling digitals template', 'model comp card template' cross-traffic — both verified as real Etsy market categories) and Gumroad discover, both merchant-of-record so no EU VAT problem; plus long-tail organic Google via free per-agency pages ('[agency name] submission requirements') funneling to the kit — no audience required for any of the three.
candidates.volume_needed: US$7,800/mo ÷ US$34 ≈ 230 sales/mo. Honest read: the verified signals prove real, recurring search demand but not its magnitude — comp-card saturation at US$9 suggests steady-but-modest Etsy traffic. 230/mo from one listing is optimistic; reaching target likely needs the English + Portuguese/Brazil editions, 3-4 listing variants, and the SEO long-tail funnel compounding over 2-3 months. First sales in days; full target [UNKNOWN] until tested.
candidates.why_prompt_cannot: ChatGPT reliably hallucinates agency-specific requirements (exact photo counts, framing, measurement formats, submission portals change and differ per agency) and a wrong spec means a rejected application. The kit is a compiled reference corpus scraped/checked from each agency's live 'get scouted' page, with per-agency links and a compile date, refreshed quarterly (free updates drive reviews). Freshness + verifiability is exactly what a prompt cannot supply.
candidates.cheapest_substitute: Models.com's free agency directory (models.com/agencies, returned 403 to my fetcher; free status [PLAUSIBLE]) — but it lists agencies, not their submission specs, digitals requirements, or scam screening; free blog guides like photogenicsmedia.com/glossary/model-submission-requirements... (fetched via search, US$0) give generic advice only. Both are partial substitutes doing part of the job — an open willingness-to-pay question per N5, not a kill.
candidates.delivery: Instant digital download (PDF + Google Sheets tracker) on Etsy/Gumroad as merchant of record. Zero per-transaction human step; buyer setup ~15 minutes. Claude Code scripts the agency-spec compile and quarterly refresh.
candidates.sol_advantage: Genuine and central: she worked as a professional model — she knows what digitals agencies actually accept, casting conventions, measurement formats, and the scam patterns that target young women, and she can ship the Brazilian/Portuguese edition (São Paulo agencies) as a native that no US Etsy seller can. This is the rare candidate where her background is the product's credibility, facelessly.
candidates.weakest_link: Price-volume conversion: the buyer skews young and free-seeking ('model comp card template free' is a live completion), so US$34 conversion is unproven and Etsy niche traffic may cap this at US$1-3k/mo — a good test, not a guaranteed target-hitter. Repeat purchase is also near-zero (each model applies once), so it shares ADV-Check's B2 weakness.
candidates.evidence: [VERIFIED] suggestqueries.google.com fetches (9 seed queries, results quoted above). [VERIFIED] creativemarket.com/search?q=comp%20card — 20+ listings at US$9-10, titles and sellers listed. [VERIFIED] html.duckduckgo.com results showing etsy.com/market/modeling_digitals_template exists. [VERIFIED] WebSearch found no paid competitor compilation. [UNKNOWN] Etsy sales counts (all Etsy fetch routes 403'd). [PLAUSIBLE] models.com directory free.

candidates.name: FLOW DECK — illustrated pose-flow library with model-side direction scripts
candidates.one_line: A US$49 pack line for portrait/wedding photographers: 100+ illustrated pose-flow chains (movement sequences, not static poses) plus the verbal cue script a professional model actually responds to, per segment (couples, boudoir, seniors, family) on Etsy/Creative Market/Gumroad.
candidates.buyer: A hobbyist-to-early-working portrait or wedding photographer who has booked a session type they are not confident directing (first couples session, first boudoir shoot).
candidates.why_they_buy_now: A paid session is on the calendar and they are afraid of the silence between poses — panic-buying a posing guide the week before a booked shoot is the established purchase pattern this category already monetizes at US$20-59.
candidates.demand_evidence: [VERIFIED, fetched creativemarket.com/search?q=posing guide] Live listings: 'Photographer Couples Posing Guide' by Signature Edits at US$59; three Blush Created guides at US$30; Soul and Flame boudoir posing guides at US$20. [VERIFIED, fetched suggestqueries.google.com] 'posing prompts for couples' is the #1 completion for 'posing prompts'; also 'posing prompts for seniors/families/maternity', 'boudoir posing guide pdf', 'boudoir posing flow', and buyers searching a paid product by name: 'boudoir posing book mike lloyd'. [VERIFIED, fetched html.duckduckgo.com] Etsy market pages exist: etsy.com/market/photographer_posing_guide and /market/posing_guide. [PLAUSIBLE, from search results incl. marybergphotography.com review] Incumbent Unscripted app: 20,000+ pose library at ~US$160/yr or US$119 one-time. Etsy listing sales counts: [UNKNOWN] (Etsy blocked).
candidates.channel: Etsy search (verified market category), Creative Market (verified price band US$20-59 with thin PDF products), Gumroad discover; all merchant-of-record.
candidates.volume_needed: US$7,800/mo ÷ US$49 ≈ 160 sales/mo, realistically spread across 4 segment packs (~40/mo each) plus a bundle. The category demonstrably sustains multiple sellers at this price, but whether a new faceless shop captures 160/mo is [UNKNOWN]; segment-pack repeat purchase (couples buyer returns for family/seniors/boudoir) is the compounding mechanism.
candidates.why_prompt_cannot: ChatGPT produces generic cue lists — the commodity part. The artefacts here are (a) illustrated movement CHAINS (pose A → transition cue → pose B) that must be visually coherent, and (b) direction scripts written from the model's side of the camera: what cue produces what body response, common client-awkwardness failure modes and their fixes. Honest caveat: gen-AI image tools are eroding the visual moat faster than in candidate 1 — this is the weaker N4 case of the two.
candidates.cheapest_substitute: Free: ExpertPhotography's 'Complete Photography Posing Guide (100+ poses)' at expertphotography.com/posing-people-in-photographs (US$0, found via DDG fetch) — static poses, no flows or cue scripts. Paid whole-job substitute: Unscripted app, US$119 one-time / ~US$160-yr [PLAUSIBLE] — the real price ceiling, which is why the pack must sell at US$39-59, not US$99.
candidates.delivery: Instant digital download (PDF + printable cards), merchant-of-record platforms, zero per-transaction human step.
candidates.sol_advantage: Real but partial: as a professional model she is literally the person photographers hire to learn direction from — the cue scripts and transition flows are her genuine craft knowledge. But the category's top sellers are photographer-educators with audiences, and she competes facelessly on marketplace search alone; her advantage is content quality, not distribution.
candidates.weakest_link: Saturation (N6-adjacent): existing US$20-59 guides plus the Unscripted app are adequate for many buyers, and 'posing cards free download pdf' is a live completion showing strong free-intent. This candidate is honestly in 'also plausible, needs a cheap test' territory rather than a hell-yes — I rank it clearly behind SIGNED KIT, and include it because it was the second-best evidenced category in the observed data, with verified prices and a verified repeat-purchase structure.
candidates.evidence: [VERIFIED] creativemarket.com/search?q=posing%20guide — listing titles, sellers, prices US$20-59 as quoted. candidates.name: ESTATE RUNBOOK — the first-time executor's complete estate-administration paper system (US)
candidates.one_line: A $59 instant-download operating system for a first-time executor: sequenced duties workbook, sourced per-state probate document checklists, an institution-by-institution notification corpus (SSA, IRS, banks, brokerages), account-closure letter templates, and reconciling inventory/expense/distribution trackers.
candidates.buyer: A 45-65 year-old adult child in the US, just named executor of a deceased parent's estate (median estates in the low-to-mid six figures), no lawyer retained yet or trying to minimise billable hours, frightened of personal liability for getting probate wrong.
candidates.why_they_buy_now: A parent died within the last 1-3 weeks. The funeral is over, the bank has frozen the accounts, the probate court has given them a filing deadline, and siblings are asking questions. They are searching 'executor of estate checklist pdf' at 11pm. The purchase moment is acute, involuntary and time-boxed.
candidates.demand_evidence: [VERIFIED] Google autocomplete fetched from suggestqueries.google.com: 'executor of estate checklist' completes to '...checklist pdf', '...duties checklist', '...checklist template'; 'estate executor spreadsheet' completes to '...spreadsheet template', 'estate administration spreadsheet template' plus five 'free estate executor spreadsheet' variants — people are actively searching, and a visible segment wants free. [VERIFIED] simplyestate.com.au/services/executor-checklists-tools/premium/ sells a 10-part executor toolkit at A$459 one-off (reg. A$589, includes 3h human support) — proof of willingness-to-pay two orders of magnitude above a checklist. [PLAUSIBLE, Etsy 403-blocks direct fetch] Etsy search snippets: 'After Death Spreadsheet' at US$18.93 by a former probate lawyer (Probate Wizard), Star Seller, with review quotes ('makes organizing an estate SO MUCH EASIER', 'really wish I had searched for this earlier'); multiple /market/ pages (estate_executor_spreadsheet, estate_executor_planner, estate_planning_binder) showing an active multi-seller category. [VERIFIED] afteradeath.com/products/after-death-spreadsheet exists as a standalone site with six testimonials. Underlying volume: ~3M US deaths/yr [PLAUSIBLE, CDC figure not fetched this session] implies a seven-figure annual flow of new executors vs ADV-Check's fixed pool of 16,779 advisers.
candidates.channel: Etsy search — the buyer types 'executor spreadsheet' / 'estate binder' into Etsy or Google and Etsy listings rank; verified autocompletes show the query stream exists. Secondary: a plain SEO page targeting 'estate executor spreadsheet template' (autocomplete-verified query) linking to the same Etsy/Payhip listing. No audience, no outreach, no face required.
candidates.volume_needed: US$7,400-8,300/mo gross needs ~135-150 sales/mo at $59 (after ~9.5% Etsy fees, ~150/mo, i.e. 5/day). Honest read: the category visibly supports Star Sellers with 'high sales volume' badges at $19, and simplyEstate proves a $300+ tier exists, but 5 sales/day at 3x the Etsy incumbent's price is category-leader performance, not a default outcome. A realistic year-one blend is Etsy volume at $49-59 plus a handful of direct sales; hitting the full target likely requires owning the 'complete system' position the way the $19 spreadsheet owns 'cheap tracker'.
candidates.why_prompt_cannot: ChatGPT produces a competent generic executor checklist — that is exactly what the free TD and LawDepot PDFs already are. What it cannot supply: (1) an assembled, cited corpus of what each of the 50 states' probate courts actually requires filed, with form numbers and links, compiled from the court websites themselves and dated; (2) an institution-by-institution notification/closure matrix (SSA, IRS, DMV, Chase, Fidelity, Vanguard, credit bureaus, airlines) of documents each actually demands, assembled from many sources; (3) deterministic trackers whose accounting reconciles inventory, expenses and distributions to the final-accounting format courts expect. A buyer terrified of personal liability wants sourced accuracy, and LLMs notoriously hallucinate state-specific procedure — the corpus IS the product.
candidates.cheapest_substitute: Free partial substitutes: TD Bank's Executor Quick-Start Checklist PDF (free, https://www.td.com/content/dam/wealth/document/pdf/wealth/executor-quick-start-checklist-en.pdf) and LawDepot's Executor Duties Checklist (free, https://www.lawdepot.com/contracts/static-forms/Executor_Duties_Checklist.pdf) — checklists only, no trackers, letters or state corpus. Cheapest paid near-substitute: Etsy 'After Death Spreadsheet' at US$18.93 [PLAUSIBLE snippet price], https://www.etsy.com/listing/1831645394/ — trackers but no letter templates or per-state/per-institution corpus. Per N5 the $18.93 product is PARTIAL, so the $59 point is an open willingness-to-pay question settled by listing it, not a kill; the A$459 simplyEstate anchor (VERIFIED) says the ceiling is well above $59.
candidates.delivery: Instant digital download (Excel + Google Sheets + PDF handbook) via Etsy, which acts as merchant of record and collects EU/UK VAT on digital items — no OSS registration for Sol. Zero per-transaction human steps; buyer setup under 30 minutes (open workbook, follow sequence). Build once with Claude Code fetching and citing the 50 state court requirements; refresh corpus quarterly.
candidates.sol_advantage: Honestly generic — her modelling and luxury-events background contributes nothing here beyond the Google PM credential (the product is literally a project plan for a grieving amateur PM). What she does bring is the ability to direct Claude Code through a 50-state corpus assembly that a typical Etsy printable-seller will not attempt. State it plainly: this candidate wins on demand mechanics, not founder edge.
candidates.weakest_link: Displacing incumbents in Etsy search: the $19 spreadsheet was built by a former probate lawyer with Star Seller status, and 5 of 10 Google autocompletes for 'estate executor spreadsheet' contain the word 'free' — a large slice of searchers won't pay at all. If the $59 'complete system' positioning doesn't visibly out-rank and out-convert the $19 'tracker' positioning, this stalls at $1-2k/mo. Also zero repeat purchase — same permanent-hunt weakness as ADV-Check (B2 not beaten).

[VERIFIED] https://afteradeath.com/products/after-death-spreadsheet — direct-site incumbent, testimonials, no counts. [VERIFIED] free substitutes exist at td.com and lawdepot.com (URLs above, surfaced in search). candidates.how_bar_is_beaten: Beats ADV-Check on B1 (need is revealed by observed purchases across a multi-seller category plus a verified A$459 comp, vs ADV-Check's unmeasured mismatch rate), on B4 (first dollar is an Etsy listing in a verified live query stream — days, not weeks of cold email from a cold domain), and on reachable demand (seven-figure annual buyer flow vs 16,779 fixed). Does NOT beat B2: repeat purchase is zero.

candidates.name: THE PRODUCTION BOOK — a luxury-events-grade wedding-day run-of-show system for couples with no planner
candidates.one_line: A $34 Etsy/Gumroad download that turns a planner-less wedding into a produced event: real call sheets, minute-by-minute run-of-show with buffer logic, vendor cue and load-in/strike schedules, contact matrices and a contingency playbook — the actual artefacts of premium brand event production, adapted to weddings.
candidates.buyer: A US bride/couple (or the maid of honor drafted as unpaid coordinator) 2-8 weeks before a $25-35k wedding, who decided not to pay $1,500-4,500 for a planner or day-of coordinator and has just realised nobody is running the day.
candidates.why_they_buy_now: The venue emailed asking 'who is your day-of point of contact?', or the photographer asked for a timeline. Panic moment, 2-8 weeks out, deadline immovable. They search 'wedding day run of show template' that night.
candidates.demand_evidence: [VERIFIED] Google autocomplete fetched from suggestqueries.google.com: 'wedding run of show' completes to '...template', '...template google sheets', 'wedding day run of show template'; 'wedding day of coordinator' completes to '...checklist', '...duties', '...contract' — the exact product query exists as a live search stream. [PLAUSIBLE, Etsy 403-blocks fetch] Etsy snippets: wedding planner spreadsheets from $0.70 to $38, sellers with 10.8k reviews (PrioriDigitalStudio) and 1.5k reviews; KellyGracePlanning at $38 marked Bestseller; 'Ultimate Wedding Day Binder' Canva template at $8.40 (orig $21), 1,121 favorites, 'high sales volume over past 6 months' badge; dedicated Etsy market pages exist for wedding_day_run_sheet, day_of_wedding_binder, wedding_day_of_coordinator_checklist. [VERIFIED] Gumroad hosts multiple wedding-planner spreadsheets (fetched effortlesswedding.gumroad.com/l/qbnale — live product, price not exposed to fetch); snippets show an $18 'Wedding Coordinator Toolkit'. Demand is enormous and proven; it is also the most saturated category I probed.
candidates.channel: Etsy search on the verified query stream ('wedding day run of show template', 'day of coordinator checklist') plus Etsy's own recommendation engine inside the wedding-template category; Gumroad/Payhip as secondary. Buyer needs zero knowledge of Sol — they are already typing the query.
candidates.volume_needed: US$7,400-8,300/mo needs ~225-245 sales/mo at $34 (7-8/day). The category demonstrably supports this — a 10.8k-review seller implies far more lifetime sales — but ONLY for top-ranked listings. A new listing doing 7-8/day within months is a top-1%-of-category outcome. Realistic path: $1-3k/mo from this listing alone; reaching target requires either category leadership or a ladder of adjacent SKUs (rehearsal-dinner run sheet, MOH coordinator pack, vendor cue-sheet pack).
candidates.why_prompt_cannot: This is the weakest N4 case of my two and I flag it honestly: ChatGPT will generate a serviceable wedding timeline free. The defensible residue is genuine domain artefacts, not information — actual call-sheet formats, cue-sheet conventions, load-in/strike scheduling logic and contingency matrices used in luxury brand activations, which Sol possesses from years inside that production world and which do not exist in generic form on the open web. It clears N4 on 'genuine domain artefacts', but by craft quality rather than by a corpus a competitor cannot copy once they see it.
candidates.cheapest_substitute: [PLAUSIBLE] Etsy 'The Ultimate Wedding Day Binder' Canva template at $8.40 on sale (orig. $21), https://www.etsy.com/listing/1156343088/ — includes editable day-of timelines, contact info sheets, photographer shot lists, coordinator info; this is close to the WHOLE job for many buyers, which is exactly why the price ceiling here is hard (~$21-38, per N5 this one IS a near-adequate substitute and caps the price). Free: template.net wedding coordinator checklists (verified to exist in search results).
candidates.delivery: Instant download (Canva link + Google Sheets + printable PDF) on Etsy (merchant of record — collects EU/UK VAT) and Gumroad (also MoR). No human step; buyer fills names/times in under 45 minutes. Faceless: sold under a studio brand, product screenshots only.
candidates.sol_advantage: Genuine and specific — this is the one Lens-2 territory where her background is the asset: she has produced premium brand events in Sao Paulo and knows what a real production book contains (cue sheets, call times, strike schedules, escalation trees) at a standard Etsy's hobbyist sellers do not reach; luxury-brand visual production values also matter in a category bought partly on aesthetics. She never appears — the artefacts do.
candidates.weakest_link: The price ceiling. Adequate incumbents at $8-38 with thousands of reviews mean this is a pure volume game in Etsy's most saturated digital category; 7-8 sales/day for a new shop is the whole bet.
